name: Dinesh Makan
bio: Dinesh combines technical depth with a people-first approach to drive Alpha Crest’s growth. Having been with the business since its early days, he plays a pivotal role in scaling the company’s operations, championing business development, and cultivating a high-performance team culture.

Dinesh creates value by connecting the dots between data analysis and stakeholder management. His expertise is grounded in a decade of operational success at Africa’s largest chemical distributor, where he was celebrated not only for outstanding financial performance but for his ability to lead through complexity—most notably representing his peers in critical arbitration negotiations. He holds a BSc Hons in Chemistry (UCT), a Post-Graduate Diploma in Marketing Management (UNISA), and was a Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP – SAPICS) for a decade.

Currently transitioning into the role of Key Individual, Dinesh is responsible for fortifying the company’s compliance and risk frameworks. When he isn’t optimizing business processes, he focuses on optimizing life—whether crafting his own wines, travelling around the world, trail running, or coaching peers to reach their full personal potential.
